user.title: Vehicle feed
user.description: Public transport vehicles that report their position to Digitransit.

data_description.lines: Line numbers such as 4 or 8A. Leave empty for every line.

data_description.max_age_minutes: Vehicles that haven't reported for longer are left out.
data_description.update_seconds: How often the sensor is updated. Vehicles report about once a second.
